admission.justification: Publication that changes the message, index shape or hook behavior would make the committed object differ from the reviewed one.

applicability: Publication message, index and hook behavior on the shared primitive.
conditions: The repository pins the cleanup mode, comment character and hook policy.
exclusions: Prepared routes, which keep their no-verify or ordinary-hook policy.
statement: Publication preserves the ruled message, index flags and hook behavior and names real ref/lock failures.
